desc: 白底主图开场，泼翻痛点、毛圈微距与卧室场景层层递进收口信任
name: 全包围深袋床笠式保护罩款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里用干净折叠成品 silhouette 抢第一眼点击，规避任何图内文字风险。
一秒把防护主张讲清楚：包装体块加泼水成珠加宠物同框，构成整套图的门面卖点。
shots.textZone: 左上深蓝区一行主标题位「{selling_point_1}」与其下一行短句位「{selling_point_2}」，底部四枚空白圆盘标签位

shots.intent: 用同机位两态对照放大日常泼翻焦虑，让买家把自己的床代入左栏。
用一只手压进毛圈的特写证明绒面手感与透气结构，替代任何文字形容。
shots.textZone: 顶部三分之一一行短标签位「{selling_point_3}」，下方三枚空白圆盘标签位

shots.intent: 展示上床动作省力，让买家代入真实家庭铺床时刻并建立尺寸直觉。
用尺寸框线与留空参数行消掉合不合床的疑虑，数值一律留白由后台填入。
shots.textZone: 左缘一枚短标签位「{callout_1}」，其下两行空参数线与一条空表格单元

shots.intent: 把护理成本降到一个动作，用洗衣房实拍感消除打理顾虑。
把功能落到生活方式收益上，用安静晨光与宠物同框制造代入感。
用同机位双栏说明包装换代不影响内物，降低收货不符的退换焦虑。
shots.textZone: 两栏各一枚空白标题带，底部一条空白说明带，不渲染任何具体字样

shots.intent: 用留空的印章框与图标条承接资质与卖点位，收口消除最后风险感。
shots.textZone: 四枚空白圆盘各带一枚短标签位「{callout_2}」，侧缘三条空参数线与一枚空白印章框

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio fields alternating between clean white #FFFFFF, deep navy #1E4E79 diagonal panels and ice-blue #DCEBF3, with pale-blue bedroom walls and matte light-oak floors for lifestyle frames
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside flat round discs, deep navy #1E4E79 on white, blank label slots under each disc
style.lightingSystem: bright soft front-left key with a bounce fill, cool neutral 5000-5600K in scenes, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium home-textile ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep navy #1E4E79, ice-mist blue #DCEBF3, clean white #FFFFFF and one warm orange accent #E4761B; cool neutral bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, bounce fill and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif used only on blank placeholder plates; thin single-weight line icons inside flat round discs; seamless studio backdrops alternating white, navy diagonal panels and ice blue, plus pale blue bedroom walls with matte light-oak floors in lifestyle frames; the textile always rendered as a soft loop-pile surface with a neatly tucked elastic skirt; stable product angle and scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no printed brand artwork on packaging
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 or straight-on product angle, consistent textile scale across the set, fitted corner detail always readable, nothing covering the skirt edge
style.surfaceSystem: soft terry-loop textile surface with a neatly tucked elastic skirt, matte light-oak flooring and pale tile
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline and short sub-line only, always carried on blank placeholder plates
